# c/pk (mode 640)
  | # a comment$
  | package pk$
  | $
  | config settings 'settings'$
  | \tlist dns_server 'tls://dns.example'$
  | \tlist dns_server "192.0.2.1"$
  | \toption  plain value$
  | \toption esc 'it'\\''s'$
  | \toption dq "a\\"b\\\\c\\td"$
  | \toption hash a#b$
  | \toption qhash 'x'#tail$
  | \toption empty ''$
  | \toption spaced a\\ b$
  | \toption multi 'line one$
  | line two'$
  | config section$
  | \toption action 'zapret'$
  | c section 'youtube' # trailing comment$
  | \to label 'You Tube'$
  | \tl tags one$
  | \tl tags 'two words'$
  | config section 'youtube'$
  | \toption extra 'merged'$
  | config autotune_target 'yt'$
  | \toption host 'www.youtube.com'$
  | \toption resolver '192.0.2.53'$
# s/pk
  | pk.autotune='autotune'$
  | pk.autotune.mode='auto'$
  | pk.autotune.confirmations='4'$
  | pk.yt.host='m.youtube.com'$
  | pk.yt.enabled='1'$
  | -pk.yt.resolver$
  | pk.extra='autotune_target'$
  | pk.extra.host='extra.example.com'$
  | pk.extra.enabled='0'$
  | -pk.extra$

# c/pk (mode 640)
  | # a comment$
  | package pk$
  | $
  | config settings 'settings'$
  | \tlist dns_server 'tls://dns.example'$
  | \tlist dns_server "192.0.2.1"$
  | \toption  plain value$
  | \toption esc 'it'\\''s'$
  | \toption dq "a\\"b\\\\c\\td"$
  | \toption hash a#b$
  | \toption qhash 'x'#tail$
  | \toption empty ''$
  | \toption spaced a\\ b$
  | \toption multi 'line one$
  | line two'$
  | config section$
  | \toption action 'zapret'$
  | c section 'youtube' # trailing comment$
  | \to label 'You Tube'$
  | \tl tags one$
  | \tl tags 'two words'$
  | config section 'youtube'$
  | \toption extra 'merged'$
  | config autotune_target 'yt'$
  | \toption host 'www.youtube.com'$
  | \toption resolver '192.0.2.53'$
# s/pk
  | pk.autotune='autotune'$
  | pk.autotune.mode='auto'$
  | pk.autotune.confirmations='4'$
  | pk.yt.host='m.youtube.com'$
  | pk.yt.enabled='1'$
  | -pk.yt.resolver$
  | pk.extra='autotune_target'$
  | pk.extra.host='extra.example.com'$
  | pk.extra.enabled='0'$
  | -pk.extra$
  | pk.settings.dns_server='single'$
  | |pk.settings.plain='second'$
  | |pk.autotune.targets='yt'$
  | ~pk.youtube.tags='one'$
  | ~pk.youtube.tags='nothere'$
  | -pk.settings.spaced$
  | pk.youtube='other_type'$
  | pk.settings.quote='it'\\''s "q" #x'$
  | pk.settings.nfqws='--filter-tcp=443 --dpi-desync=fake'$
  | pk.settings.lines='one$
  | two'$

# c/pk (mode 640)
  | $
  | config settings 'settings'$
  | \toption dns_server 'single'$
  | \tlist plain 'value'$
  | \tlist plain 'second'$
  | \toption esc 'it'\\''s'$
  | \toption dq 'a"b\\ctd'$
  | \toption hash 'a'$
  | \toption qhash 'x'$
  | \toption multi 'line one$
  | line two'$
  | \toption quote 'it'\\''s "q" #x'$
  | \toption nfqws '--filter-tcp=443 --dpi-desync=fake'$
  | \toption lines 'one$
  | two'$
  | $
  | config section$
  | \toption action 'zapret'$
  | $
  | config other_type 'youtube'$
  | \toption label 'You Tube'$
  | \tlist tags 'two words'$
  | \toption extra 'merged'$
  | $
  | config autotune_target 'yt'$
  | \toption host 'm.youtube.com'$
  | \toption enabled '1'$
  | $
  | config autotune 'autotune'$
  | \toption mode 'auto'$
  | \toption confirmations '4'$
  | \tlist targets 'yt'$
  | $
